_comment: MILL TAILINGS: the radioactive dump's bulk stream (#285).
Tailings are what is left after uranium is extracted - sandy, low grade, and produced in
volumes too large to contain. So the stream is mostly spoil: sand, gravel, stone shards, with
the occasional piece of the plant that processed it.
URANINITE ARRIVES AS A TAG ENTRY, and expand:true is load-bearing.
It is Powah's item, so naming powah:uraninite_raw directly would kill this whole table at
parse when Powah is absent - an item id resolves against the registry when the file is read.
A TagKey does not resolve at parse time, so #c:raw_materials/uraninite is simply inert.
expand:true makes a tag contribute ONE ENTRY PER MEMBER, so with Powah absent it contributes
NONE and this pool falls back to the five spoil entries with no dud roll. expand:false would
leave a single entry holding weight 55 that wins one roll in five and hands back nothing -
the silent empty pull that shipped in #276 and was caught in review of #277.
RAW rather than refined, deliberately: c:raw_materials/uraninite is powah:uraninite_raw, and
Powah's own uraninite_from_raw smelts it. Finding raw ore in tailings and processing it is
what tailings ARE - the spent rock that still has some uranium left in it.
Weights are first pass; #36 owns them.
